readme:
# DeepCluster 聚类伪标签学习


## 1. 问题


实现 `normalize_features`、`assign_clusters` 和 `pseudo_label_loss`。DeepCluster 交替进行特征聚类与簇标签预测，让编码器从自己的表示生成监督信号。本题从已完成 PCA/白化的特征开始，提取 L2 归一化、最近簇分配和伪标签训练三个核心步骤。


## 2. 核心公式


对给定特征 $x_i$，令 $z_i=x_i/\max(\|x_i\|_2,\epsilon)$。欧氏 K-means 给出
$$y_i=\arg\min_k\|z_i-c_k\|_2^2,\quad L=\frac1B\sum_i[\operatorname{logsumexp}_k(s_{ik})-s_{i,y_i}].$$
中心是簇内算术平均，长度不必为 1；不能擅自把欧氏分配换成余弦最大值。同距取最小中心索引。均匀 logits 的损失为 `log(K)`。


## 3. 公式到代码


按行计算带下界的范数，广播计算特征到各中心的平方距离，再沿中心维取 `argmin`。离散簇标签必须与梯度图分离；训练路径的归一化和全部分类 logits 保留梯度。用稳定的 log-sum-exp 计算样本平均交叉熵。


## 4. 本题约定


浮点矩阵为非空、有限的 float32/float64，同宽、同 dtype/device。标签为范围内 int64。默认 `eps=1e-12`，零向量归一化后仍为零；支持非连续输入，不修改输入。分配函数接收调用方已归一化的特征，不归一化中心。损失只对给定样本求均值；原系统通过采样平衡簇，本函数不会自动插入类别权重。starter 已提供输入验证。


## 5. 交互图与 CPU 实验


九个确定性二维点形成三个簇，2×2 编码器和 2×3 分类头共十个可训练参数。以学习率 `.25` 做 90 次 SGD，在第 0、30、60、90 步更新伪标签和簇均值；空簇保留旧中心。实验实际调用三个待实现函数。T3 要求三个簇均被占用、编码器移动量大于 `.01`、伪标签准确率为 1、最终损失低于 `.1`。这些指标只描述合成训练，不包含 PCA 拟合或图像编码器复现。


## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 延伸与来源


原系统在整批图像特征上重新拟合 PCA/白化与 K-means，再用簇平衡采样训练。完成核心后可研究这些外层策略，并比较 SwAV 的平衡软分配和跨视图预测。论文与官方实现见下方。合成数据、边界约定、测试与微型优化器是本题教学设计。


[Deep Clustering for Unsupervised Learning of Visual Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.05520) · [Official implementation](https://github.com/facebookresearch/deepcluster/blob/main/clustering.py)

# 实现提示

建议先独立完成练习，再查看本页。

按行计算带下界的范数，广播计算特征到各中心的平方距离，再沿中心维取 `argmin`。离散簇标签必须与梯度图分离；训练路径的归一化和全部分类 logits 保留梯度。用稳定的 log-sum-exp 计算样本平均交叉熵。

浮点矩阵为非空、有限的 float32/float64，同宽、同 dtype/device。标签为范围内 int64。默认 `eps=1e-12`，零向量归一化后仍为零；支持非连续输入，不修改输入。分配函数接收调用方已归一化的特征，不归一化中心。损失只对给定样本求均值；原系统通过采样平衡簇，本函数不会自动插入类别权重。starter 已提供输入验证。

## 小实验与阈值

九个确定性二维点形成三个簇，2×2 编码器和 2×3 分类头共十个可训练参数。以学习率 `.25` 做 90 次 SGD，在第 0、30、60、90 步更新伪标签和簇均值；空簇保留旧中心。实验实际调用三个待实现函数。T3 要求三个簇均被占用、编码器移动量大于 `.01`、伪标签准确率为 1、最终损失低于 `.1`。这些指标只描述合成训练，不包含 PCA 拟合或图像编码器复现。

数据和初始化均为确定性；测试 fixture 还将 Python、NumPy、PyTorch 的种子设为 42。原生标定环境为 Apple silicon 上仓库固定的 PyTorch 2.14.1 CPU。NumPy 自动微分适配器与导出的 WASM 包运行同一套完整训练测试。断言证明本合成任务上的数值和学习行为，不代表论文基准复现。

## 错误实现检查

以下每个 mutant 仅隔离一种错误，完整说明对应题面约定：

- 沿批次而非每行特征进行归一化。
- 选择最远簇而非最近簇。
- 用未归一化的点积替代欧氏距离分配。
- 对样本损失求和而非求均值。
- 把所有簇标签当成第 0 类。
- 切断特征归一化的梯度。

来源：[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.05520) 与 [官方代码](https://github.com/facebookresearch/deepcluster/blob/main/clustering.py)。

原生参考解实测：initial_loss=1.09861; final_loss=0.0695958; initial_accuracy=0.333333; final_accuracy=1。

非零行的范数小于 eps 时属于 z=x/eps 的线性分支，非连续父张量上对应 VJP 为 g/eps，未使用存储梯度为零。只单独处理全零行会漏掉此边界。

en.title: DeepCluster: Learning from Cluster Pseudo-Labels
en.readme:
# DeepCluster: Learning from Cluster Pseudo-Labels


## 1. Problem


Implement `normalize_features`, `assign_clusters`, and `pseudo_label_loss`. DeepCluster repeatedly groups current image features and trains an encoder to predict those cluster IDs. The labels come from the representation, not annotated categories. This module starts after the paper's PCA/whitening preprocessing; it isolates the L2, nearest-center and pseudo-label training steps.


## 2. Core equations


For supplied whitened rows $x_i$, set $z_i=x_i/\max(\|x_i\|_2,\epsilon)$. Given ordinary K-means centers $c_k$,
$$y_i=\arg\min_k\|z_i-c_k\|_2^2,\qquad L=\frac1B\sum_i[\operatorname{logsumexp}_k(s_{ik})-s_{i,y_i}].$$
Centers are arithmetic means and need not have unit length. Do not turn this Euclidean assignment into a cosine classifier. Ties choose the lowest center index. Uniform logits produce `log(K)`.


## 3. Equations to code


Normalize feature rows with a norm floor, broadcast feature-center differences and reduce over the feature axis, then take `argmin` over centers. Cluster assignment is a detached, discrete target. Classification gradients flow through all logits; normalization remains differentiable when used in the encoder path. Use stable log-sum-exp for mean cross entropy.


## 4. Exercise conventions


All floating matrices are finite float32/float64, nonempty, with matching feature widths, dtype and device. Labels are int64 and in range. Accept strided inputs and leave them intact. Zero rows normalize to zero; the norm floor is `eps=1e-12`. `assign_clusters` accepts features already normalized by the caller and does not renormalize centers. Loss is a mean over supplied examples: the original training sampler balances clusters; this function does not silently insert class weights. Provided validation remains in the starter.


## 5. Interactive plots and CPU lab


The lab alternates cluster refresh and real learning on nine deterministic 2D points. A 2×2 encoder and 2×3 head have ten trainable entries. It performs 90 SGD updates at learning rate `.25`, refreshing assignments and mean centers at updates 0, 30, 60 and 90. Empty toy centers retain their previous values. The supplied experiment calls all three submitted functions. T3 requires all three clusters occupied, encoder motion above `.01`, pseudo-label accuracy 1 and final loss below `.1`. These are synthetic training metrics, without fitting PCA or training an image encoder.


## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Extensions and sources


The original system refits PCA/whitening and K-means over extracted image features and retrains with cluster-balanced sampling. Study those outer-loop decisions after completing this core. Compare SwAV, which uses balanced soft assignments and swapped-view prediction. Paper and official implementation are linked below. The toy data, boundary choices, tests and small optimizer are original teaching material.


[Deep Clustering for Unsupervised Learning of Visual Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.05520) · [Official implementation](https://github.com/facebookresearch/deepcluster/blob/main/clustering.py)
en.notes:
# Implementation notes

Read these after attempting the exercise.

Normalize feature rows with a norm floor, broadcast feature-center differences and reduce over the feature axis, then take `argmin` over centers. Cluster assignment is a detached, discrete target. Classification gradients flow through all logits; normalization remains differentiable when used in the encoder path. Use stable log-sum-exp for mean cross entropy.

All floating matrices are finite float32/float64, nonempty, with matching feature widths, dtype and device. Labels are int64 and in range. Accept strided inputs and leave them intact. Zero rows normalize to zero; the norm floor is `eps=1e-12`. `assign_clusters` accepts features already normalized by the caller and does not renormalize centers. Loss is a mean over supplied examples: the original training sampler balances clusters; this function does not silently insert class weights. Provided validation remains in the starter.

The maintained mutations isolate these faults:

- Normalize columns instead of feature rows.
- Choose the farthest cluster.
- Replace Euclidean assignment with unnormalized dot products.
- Sum pseudo-label losses across examples.
- Treat every cluster label as zero.
- Stop gradients through feature normalization.

## Actual CPU calibration

The lab alternates cluster refresh and real learning on nine deterministic 2D points. A 2×2 encoder and 2×3 head have ten trainable entries. It performs 90 SGD updates at learning rate `.25`, refreshing assignments and mean centers at updates 0, 30, 60 and 90. Empty toy centers retain their previous values. The supplied experiment calls all three submitted functions. T3 requires all three clusters occupied, encoder motion above `.01`, pseudo-label accuracy 1 and final loss below `.1`. These are synthetic training metrics, without fitting PCA or training an image encoder.

All data and initial parameters are deterministic; the test fixture also seeds Python/NumPy/PyTorch to 42. Native calibration uses the repository's PyTorch 2.14.1 CPU environment on Apple silicon. Tests use the same full training loop in the NumPy autograd adapter and exported WASM bundle. The gates validate numerical behavior and learning on this synthetic task, not a published paper benchmark.

Source: [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.05520) and [official implementation](https://github.com/facebookresearch/deepcluster/blob/main/clustering.py).

Observed native reference metrics: initial_loss=1.09861; final_loss=0.0695958; initial_accuracy=0.333333; final_accuracy=1.

Nonzero rows shorter than eps belong to the linear branch z=x/eps. The strided parent VJP there is g/eps, with zero gradients in unused storage. Handling only exactly zero rows misses this boundary.
